description: Find the meeting rooms that are free for the whole of a time range, optionally with a minimum capacity and required features. Book one with create_event, inviting its email address with cutype ROOM.

end.description: UTC time, YYYYMMDDTHHmmssZ or ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-12T14:00:00Z

features.description: Features the room must have, e.g. ["PROJECTOR", "VIDEO-CONFERENCING"]. Others: PHONE, TV, WHITEBOARD, WHEELCHAIR-ACCESSIBLE

start.description: UTC time, YYYYMMDDTHHmmssZ or ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-12T14:00:00Z

name: find_free_rooms
title: Find Free Rooms
